-- Insert 3 example workflows to demonstrate system usage
-- Simplified version - stages will be created through UI workflow

-- Get template IDs
SET @pr_template_id = (SELECT id FROM workflow_templates WHERE workflow_type = 'PR' AND name = 'Purchase Request (PR)' LIMIT 1);
SET @budget_template_id = (SELECT id FROM workflow_templates WHERE workflow_type = 'Budget' LIMIT 1);
SET @maf_template_id = (SELECT id FROM workflow_templates WHERE workflow_type = 'MAF' LIMIT 1);

SET @requester_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'eddie.amintohir@compawnion.co' LIMIT 1);

-- ========================================
-- Example 1: Office Supplies Purchase Request
-- ========================================
INSERT INTO workflows (
  id, workflow_number, workflow_type, template_id, title, description,
  requester_id, department, estimated_amount, currency,
  current_stage, overall_status, created_at, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  UUID(),
  'WFMT-PR-260223-EX1',
  'PR',
  @pr_template_id,
  '[EXAMPLE] Office Supplies Purchase - Printer Paper & Stationery',
  'Monthly office supplies procurement for PPIC department including printer paper, pens, folders, and sticky notes. This is a reference example showing how to use the Purchase Request template.',
  @requester_id,
  'PPIC',
  2500000.00,
  'IDR',
  NULL,
  'draft',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);

-- ========================================
-- Example 2: Marketing Campaign Budget Request
-- ========================================
INSERT INTO workflows (
  id, workflow_number, workflow_type, template_id, title, description,
  requester_id, department, estimated_amount, currency,
  current_stage, overall_status, created_at, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  UUID(),
  'WFMT-Budget-260223-EX2',
  'Budget',
  @budget_template_id,
  '[EXAMPLE] Q1 2026 Digital Marketing Campaign Budget',
  'Budget request for Q1 digital marketing campaign including social media ads, Google Ads, and influencer partnerships. Expected ROI: 3.5x. This is a reference example showing how to use the Budget Request template.',
  @requester_id,
  'Marketing',
  50000000.00,
  'IDR',
  NULL,
  'draft',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);

-- ========================================
-- Example 3: Production Material Authorization
-- ========================================
INSERT INTO workflows (
  id, workflow_number, workflow_type, template_id, title, description,
  requester_id, department, estimated_amount, currency,
  current_stage, overall_status, created_at, updated_at
)
VALUES (
  UUID(),
  'WFMT-MAF-260223-EX3',
  'MAF',
  @maf_template_id,
  '[EXAMPLE] Raw Material Authorization - Steel Sheets for Product Line A',
  'Authorization to withdraw 500kg of steel sheets from warehouse for Product Line A production batch #2026-02-001. Estimated completion: March 15, 2026. This is a reference example showing how to use the Material Authorization Form template.',
  @requester_id,
  'Production',
  15000000.00,
  'IDR',
  NULL,
  'draft',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
);
